## Drivingexceptionaloutcomesforourclients

Since its inception, CyberCube has been committed to transforming complex cyber threats into clear, actionable strategies, translating cyber risk into financial impact on businesses, markets and society as a whole.

We are revolutionizing cyber risk quantification with the unmatched power of artificial intelligence (AI). As leaders in AI, we don’t just use the technology, we shape it.

With CyberCube, you’re not just securing your present — you’re safeguarding your business's future with the ultimate fusion of AI innovation and cyber risk expertise in the insurance industry.

#### Journey

## OurJourney

#### Journey

swipe

drag

### 2015

Starting as a division of Symantec, the global leader in cybersecurity, we developed and validated SaaS products for the cyber insurance industry with Pascal Millaire as General Manager.

![symantec](https://www.cybcube.com/hubfs/WEBSITE/Website%20Images/symantec.jpg)

### 2018

CyberCube launched as a standalone, independent VC-backed company in 2018. With a Series A capital raise backed by cybersecurity specialist VC, Forgepoint Capital, we opened our offices in San Francisco and London.

![forgepoint-capital](https://www.cybcube.com/hubfs/WEBSITE/Website%20Images/forgepoint-capital.jpg)

### 2019

We raised Series B capital, led by Hudson Structured Capital Management (Bermuda) alongside MTech Capital and individuals from Stone Point Capital. We expanded our offices into Tallinn, Estonia.

![hudson-structured](https://www.cybcube.com/hubfs/WEBSITE/Website%20Images/hudson-structured.jpg)

### 2022

CyberCube gains additional growth capital from investment funds managed by Morgan Stanley Tactical Value. Office expansion continues in New York and Chicago.

![morgan stanley logo](https://www.cybcube.com/hubfs/WEBSITE/Website%20Images/morgan%20stanley%20logo.jpeg)

### 2023

CyberCube partnered with over 100 leading institutions, reflecting the impact of our financial analytics on improving the resilience of organizations and society. Clients include over two-thirds of the global cyber (re)insurance market, by premium.

![Foresight NYC 2024 timeline](https://www.cybcube.com/hubfs/WEBSITE/New%20Website%20Images/About%20Us%20-%20Timeline%20images/Foresight%20NYC%202024%20timeline.jpeg)

### 2025

In 2025, Spectrum Equity joined some of CyberCube’s existing financial partners as a new cornerstone investor. With a $180+ million investment, Spectrum Equity is accelerating CyberCube’s global growth and fueling innovation across our end-to-end cyber risk analytics for the insurance industry.

![Spectrum_Logo-dark](https://www.cybcube.com/hubfs/Spectrum_Logo-dark.png)

### Our Culture

We put people at the forefront of our mission, encouraging CyberCubers to challenge themselves, solve problems with intellectual rigor and push boundaries to deliver excellence.

Employee wellbeing, personal development and building trust through openness are essential. Cultivating this positive and inclusive work environment means our employees can do the best work of their career.

![London volunteer day gardening](https://www.cybcube.com/hubfs/WEBSITE/Website%20Images/London%20volunteer%20day%20gardening.jpg)

### Our Responsibility to ESG

It is important that the CyberCube team is supported and inspired to make our organization a leading creator of sustainable value to society. Our cross-functional [Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG)](https://www.cybcube.com/corporate-social-responsibility) team fulfills various goals to accomplish this.

We are also signatories to the [United Nations Global Compact initiative](https://unglobalcompact.org/what-is-gc/participants/141615-CyberCube-Analytics), committing to conducting our business with sustainability in mind alongside thousands of companies globally.

[Read More](https://www.cybcube.com/corporate-social-responsibility)

![5](https://www.cybcube.com/hubfs/WEBSITE/Website%20Images/5.jpg)

### Innovation is Critical

At CyberCube, innovation is essential in our mission to deliver cyber risk analytics. Our solutions are supported by verified, best-in-class data, advanced application of human- and AI-driven insights, and industry expertise.

We pride ourselves on staying ahead of the cyber risk curve. Our solutions are powered by people, while also leveraging AI where appropriate as a core component of our multidimensional approach.

## LifeatCyberCube

At CyberCube, employees energize and inspire each other in their work — taking the initiative to think outside the box and discover new ways to solve problems.

If you want to apply your knowledge and insight to make an impact, CyberCube is the home for you. Find your place with us and start delivering the world’s leading cyber analytics.
